items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: the band that I left Opelousas with, Dr. Moon Medicine Company it was called, was owned by a millionaire -- and his name was Doctor Moon... Doctor Moon said, 'You can pay me back two dollars a week.' I said, 'Okay,' and that's when I started playing.

ctx.x: Not always. The band that I left Opelousas with, Dr. Moon Medicine Company it was called, was owned by a millionaire -- and his name was Doctor Moon. I don't know I think they called him Frank or whatever. But I never called him anything...nobody called him anything but Dr. Moon.
What was the purpose of you going with them?
